title: Task Scheduler with Cooldown
statement: Given an array of CPU tasks represented by uppercase letters (e.g. A B C) and a non-negative integer cooldown N. Between two identical tasks, there must be at least N intervals of cooling. Return the least number of intervals the CPU will take to finish all tasks.
input_format: First line: string of task characters separated by spaces. Second line: cooldown integer N.
output_format: Output a single integer representing minimum total intervals.
sample_input:
A A A B B B
2

hidden_tests.input:
A A A B B B
0
